evals.prompt: The getDisplayName helper is duplicated across features/profile and features/settings. Extract it into a shared package and update all callers.
evals.expected_output: Present the plan to the user for approval before pre-flight: show the Step list, Non-goals, and Risks summary. Do not dive into pre-flight or editing before confirmation. The plan uses the step template (File(s), Action, Verification, Rollback, Depends on) and has Goal, Non-goals (hard fence), Constraints and Invariants, Target State, Pre-flight, Steps[], Testing Strategy, Definition of Done, and Risks. Pre-flight runs the narrowest gate and records a known-good baseline on a dedicated branch before step 1.
expectations: Presents the plan to the user for approval BEFORE running pre-flight or editing code (the approval gate: show Step list, Non-goals, Risks summary)
The plan includes Goal, Non-goals (hard fence), Constraints and Invariants, Target State, Pre-flight, Steps[], Testing Strategy, and Definition of Done
Pre-flight runs the narrowest gate for the change scope and records a known-good baseline on a dedicated branch before step 1

evals.prompt: Rename the shared UserCard component to ProfileCard across the whole monorepo. It is used in maybe 30 files across apps/web and packages/ui.
evals.expected_output: Sequence this wide refactor as expand-contract, not a single vertical step. Expand: add the new ProfileCard form beside the old UserCard (one step, nothing breaks). Migrate: update call sites in batches sized by blast radius (per package/directory), each batch its own step blocked by the expand, keeping the gate green batch to batch because the old form still exists. Contract: delete the old UserCard once no caller remains (one step, blocked by every migrate batch). If even batches cannot stay green alone, share an integration branch with a final integrate-and-verify step.
expectations: Sequences the wide rename as expand-contract (add new form beside old; migrate call sites in batches per package/directory; delete old form last), not a single vertical step
The expand step adds the new ProfileCard form beside the old UserCard so nothing breaks
Migrate batches are sized by blast radius (per package/directory), each its own step blocked by the expand
The contract step deletes the old UserCard only once no caller remains, blocked by every migrate batch

evals.prompt: While I am extracting getDisplayName into the shared package in step 2, can I also change it to return a formatted full name with title case instead of the raw value? It is right there in the same function.
evals.expected_output: Reject mixing feature work into a refactor step. A refactor changes structure, not observable behavior. Changing the return value to title-cased formatted output is a behavior change — that belongs in a separate plan, not the same step. Non-goals are a hard fence equal in weight to the goal. Split any step that adds behavior into a separate plan.
expectations: Rejects mixing the title-case formatting behavior change into the refactor step (refactor changes structure, not observable behavior)
States that behavior changes belong in a separate plan, not the same step
Cites the Non-goals hard-fence rule: any step that adds behavior is out of scope and must be split into a separate plan
